# arXiv.org

> arXiv is a free, open-access preprint repository for physics, mathematics, computer science, and quantitative biology research.

Founded and maintained by Cornell University with support from the Simons Foundation, arXiv serves as a central hub for researchers to share preprints before formal peer review. The platform hosts papers across multiple scientific disciplines organized into subject categories with daily new submissions and browsable archives.

## Key Topics

- Preprint archive
- Open-access research
- Physics
- Mathematics
- Computer Science

## Getting Started

- [arXiv.org e-Print archive](https://arxiv.org): arXiv homepage: open-access preprint repository for Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, and Quantitative Biology
- [About arXiv](https://info.arxiv.org/about): About arXiv: mission, history, governance, and funding by Cornell University and Simons Foundation
- [arXiv Help Contents](https://info.arxiv.org/help): Comprehensive help documentation covering submissions, accounts, search, API, and technical standards

## Astrophysics

- [Astrophysics](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph/new): New astrophysics preprint submissions including pulsars and coronal mass ejection research
- [Astrophysics - Recent](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph/recent): Recent astrophysics preprint submissions and research papers in astro-ph category
- [Astrophysics of Galaxies](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.GA/recent): Recent galaxy astrophysics papers: star formation, AGN, metallicity, and galactic structure
- [Cosmology and Nongalactic Astrophysics](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.CO/recent): Recent cosmology and nongalactic astrophysics: CMB, BAO, primordial black holes, 21cm
- [Earth and Planetary Astrophysics](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.EP/recent): Recent exoplanet and planetary science papers: hot Jupiters, tidal dynamics research
- [High Energy Astrophysical Phenomena](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.HE/recent): Recent high-energy astrophysics: gamma-ray bursts, black holes, neutron stars, cosmic rays
- [Instrumentation and Methods for Astrophysics](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.IM/recent): Recent astrophysics instrumentation and methods: spectroscopy, ML, radio astronomy
- [Solar and Stellar Astrophysics](https://arxiv.org/list/astro-ph.SR/recent): Recent solar and stellar astrophysics: magnetic fields, lithium depletion, Kepler data

## Condensed Matter Physics & Materials Science

- [Condensed Matter](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat/new): New condensed matter physics and materials science preprint submissions
- [Condensed Matter - Recent](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat/recent): Recent condensed matter physics: quantum gases, Bose-Einstein condensates, correlations
- [Disordered Systems and Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat.dis-nn/recent): Recent disordered systems and neural networks: phase transitions, spin glass, Anderson
- [Materials Science](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat.mtrl-sci/recent): Recent materials science papers: ferroelectrics, nanocrystals, heterostructures
- [Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat.mes-hall/recent): Recent mesoscale and nanoscale physics: quantum Hall systems, topological structures
- [Other Condensed Matter](https://arxiv.org/list/cond-mat.other/recent): Recent condensed matter physics papers: quantum systems, nanotechnology, topological

## Support & Community

- [Donate - arXiv](https://info.arxiv.org/about/donate.html): Donation page for arXiv, supported by Cornell University and Benevity
